reason: TRANSFORM-2 (NCT02418585). Served observed-case arm means printed in the registry: -21.4 (SD 12.32, n 101) vs -17.0 (SD 13.88, n 100); the dispersion type is Standard Deviation. The extractor's SET_ASIDE is rejected as for P53-16.

population.span: The study enrolled adults with moderate to severe nonpsychotic depression and a history of nonresponse to at least two antidepressants in the current episode, with one antidepressant assessed prospectively.

endpoint.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 [PRIMARY]: Change From Baseline in Montgomery-Asberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) Total Score up to Day 28 in the Double-blind Induction Phase- Mixed-Effects Model Using Repeated Measures (MMRM) Analysis

arm_means.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 MEASUREMENT : Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD)=-21.4 (spread 12.32); Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD=-17.0 (spread 13.88)

denominators.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 DENOM Participants: Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD)=101; Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD=100

dispersion_is_sd.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 DISPERSION TYPE: Standard Deviation

gap_analysis_set.span: Full analysis set (FAS) defined as all randomized participants who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication, 1 dose of oral antidepressant (AD) medication during double-blind induction phase (D-BIP).

gap_follow_up.span: Baseline up to Day 28 of Double-blind Induction Phase

gap_entry_age.span: At the time of signing the informed consent form (ICF), participant must be a man or woman 18 (or older if the minimum legal age of consent in the country in which the study is taking place is greater than \[\>\]18) to 64 years of age, inclusive

typed_estimand.analysis_set: observed cases at Day 28 within the FAS (denominators = participants with Day-28 data)
typed_estimand.treatment_strategy: intranasal esketamine + new oral AD vs intranasal placebo + new oral AD
